nodes.label: Server API
nodes.rationale: Express API discovers, ingests, and serves public transport data without a database.

nodes.label: GTFS runtime discovery
nodes.rationale: Runtime discovery with fallbacks prevents upstream portal moves from breaking timetable loading.

nodes.label: Independent vehicle-source merging
nodes.rationale: MPK and municipal Open Data are independently polled and spatially matched so either source can continue serving useful fleet data.

nodes.label: Browser map
nodes.rationale: The mobile-first browser client is a self-contained map, controls, alerts, and departure sheet with no build step.

nodes.label: Render deployment
nodes.rationale: A persistent disk retains the GTFS cache so a portal outage or restart does not discard the last good timetable.

nodes.label: apiGet
nodes.rationale: Retries server 503 responses during GTFS cold-start ingestion and honors conditional response caching.

nodes.label: renderVehicles
nodes.rationale: Existing Leaflet markers are keyed by vehicle id and moved rather than reconstructed, preserving selection and preventing fleet blinking.

nodes.label: Wroclive landing page
nodes.author: real-kijmoshi
nodes.rationale: A Polish public marketing page uses railway-blue branding, live green only for live state, and an operational display aesthetic.

nodes.label: MapSurfaceProps contract
nodes.rationale: A declarative contract keeps native react-native-maps and Leaflet implementations behaviorally aligned while isolating platform-specific work.

nodes.label: Marker stability rule
nodes.rationale: Markers must be moved and icon changes limited to 15° heading buckets because rebuilding made the fleet blink, closed open UI, and lost selection.

nodes.label: apiGet client boundary
nodes.rationale: All app requests use apiGet and normalisers so server startup 503 payloads cannot become invalid UI state.

nodes.label: Leaflet command readiness
nodes.rationale: Commands are queued until the map handler is available because page readiness can precede host listeners or iframe load handling.

nodes.label: Wrocław skyline icon background
nodes.rationale: A pale-blue skyline with recognizable church spires and a cable-stayed bridge locates the transit product in Wrocław.

nodes.label: Blue location pin layer
nodes.rationale: The large blue pin and route-like sweep signify live map location and routing.

nodes.label: Tram illustration layer
nodes.rationale: A blue-and-white overhead-wire tram with fleet number 3324 makes public transport the focal subject.

nodes.label: Dark Wroclive app icon
nodes.rationale: A dark icon composes Wrocław skyline, blue map pin, tracked tram, rail curves, and Wroclive wordmark for high contrast in dark contexts.
